description: Retire the legacy Mission-Standard runtime. The engine directory (runtime/mission-standard) is removed and every launch/execution path now reuses the modern shared Runtime (runtime/bin/odg-run.js + runtime/bin/odg-verify.js) via the thin relocation runtime/bin/odg-fallback.sh. No mission depends on a distinct legacy engine anymore: the local fallback IS the modern deterministic pipeline. This contract turns that already-achieved retirement into machine-verified evidence so the Runtime can converge honestly.

objectives.goal: Confirm the legacy runtime/mission-standard engine directory is removed.
done_when: runtime/mission-standard does not exist on disk

objectives.goal: Confirm no live launcher or execution path references the legacy engine.
done_when: no live .sh/.js launch or execution file references mission-standard

objectives.goal: Confirm the Runtime stays green after retirement (build + TypeScript gates).

definition_of_done: No live code path references the legacy engine.
Mission proven in the immutable Mission Ledger.
completion: RETIRE_LEGACY_RUNTIME proven and archived in the Mission Ledger.
